attempts.text: [{"name": "same_code_sibling_recency", "idea": "Days since the user last bought a different article with the same product_code (same model in another colour or size), kept as a single column to avoid the redundant pair rejected in r1p4.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ut AS (SELECT t.customer_id, t.article_id, a.product_code, t.t_dat FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), ca AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, a.product_code FROM cand c JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.article_id) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.article_id, COALESCE(MIN(date_diff('day', ut.t_dat, DATE '{A}')), 91) AS ag_sibling_recency FROM ca LEFT JOIN ut ON ut.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND ut.product_code = ca.product_code AND ut.article_id <> ca.article_id GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.article_id;"}, {"name": "basket_copurchase28", "idea": "Sum over the user's 28-day articles of how many full-population same-day baskets also contained the candidate, an item-to-item signal that personalizes the global candidates.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ua AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_id, t.article_id FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT article_id FROM ua), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, t_dat, article_id FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 28 DAY), co AS (SELECT x.article_id AS a1, y.article_id AS a2, COUNT(*) AS n FROM b x JOIN src s ON x.article_id = s.article_id JOIN b y ON x.customer_id = y.customer_id AND x.t_dat = y.t_dat AND x.article_id <> y.article_id GROUP BY x.article_id, y.article_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, COALESCE(SUM(co.n), 0) AS ag_copurch28 FROM cand c LEFT JOIN ua ON ua.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN co ON co.a1 = ua.article_id AND co.a2 = c.article_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.article_id;"}, {"name": "ui_old_history", "idea": "User-item transaction rows between 90 and 365 days ago, capturing seasonal repurchase of items that fall outside every existing 90-day window.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ut AS (SELECT t.customer_id, t.article_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 365 DAY AND t.t_dat < DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.article_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, COALESCE(ut.n, 0) AS ag_ui_tx90_365 FROM cand c LEFT JOIN ut ON ut.customer_id = c.customer_id AND ut.article_id = c.article_id;"}, {"name": "item_price_drop", "idea": "Ratio of the article's mean price in the last 7 days to its mean price 8-90 days ago, flagging markdowns that drive next-week sales.", "level": "article", "sql": "WITH p AS (SELECT article_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN price END) AS p7, AVG(CASE WHEN t_dat < DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN price END) AS pold FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY article_id) SELECT article_id, p7 / pold AS ag_price_ratio7_90 FROM p WHERE p7 IS NOT NULL AND pold IS NOT NULL AND pold > 0;"}, {"name": "product_code_buyers7", "idea": "Distinct buyers in the last 7 days of the article's whole product_code family, so low-volume colourways of a hot model get credit that i_buyers7 misses.", "level": "article", "sql": "WITH pc AS (SELECT a2.product_code, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS n FROM tx t JOIN articles a2 ON t.article_id = a2.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY a2.product_code) SELECT a.article_id, COALESCE(pc.n, 0) AS ag_code_buyers7 FROM articles a LEFT JOIN pc ON pc.product_code = a.product_code;"}]
